notes.title: Update on My House is Haunted
notes.content:
Hello everyone, this is Pogu. Today, I would like to share to you guys about My House is Haunted is going to be first person shooter. There will be going to be a leveling system. Most of the time, hordes of zombie or ghost will come to you and you as a player will shoot them. Pretty basic gameplay with additional upgrades on gun skills and whatnot similar to Vampire Survivor. Last week, I made a progress to create the character controller for first person shooter. It looks good to me. Next I will tackle how to approach the hordes of enemies.

That's about it, peace!

notes.title: My House Is Haunted is taking different path
notes.content:
Hello, this is Pogu, I'm here to update you guys the current state of the game. First of all, I would like to apologize because of the late update. My House is Haunted is my first commercial and it is too ambitious for me. As a solo indie game developer, making multiplayer as your first game is really not a good idea. Thus, It flop, and I lost my motivation to continue moving forward with this game. However, I just can't get rid of the feeling of going back and fix this game. I don't know why but this game have special place in my heart. Maybe because it's my first commercial game?


Moving forward, I plan to rework My House is Haunted into something totally different. I will remove the multiplayer function and make it as a single player. I will turn this game into first person shooting game with vampire survivor element. I hope you guys look forward in the complete release game coming in a few months.

Sincerely,


Pogu
